main.description: Internal — invoked by the aismarine-consumer K8s Deployment to flush a batch of decoded AIS messages into vertex_vessel + vertex_vessel_position. Authentication: x-internal-trust 3-header HMAC (per ADR-2604241038 invariant 3). Not part of the public surface; never registered to MCP. ADR-2605011500.

positions.description: Array of position rows: { mmsi, ts_ms, lat, lon, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status?, source }. Max 1000 per call.

masters.description: Array of master upserts from AIS Type-5 broadcasts: { mmsi, imo?, callsign?, name?, type_code?, length_m?, width_m?, draught_m?, source, ts_ms }. Optional, max 200.
